page.overview:
Who is Jack Hammer?

Jack Hammer, or Drill Bit, is a male background pony who appears both as a Pegasus and as an Earth pony. He has a light brown coat, two-toned dark gray mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark usually of a screwdriver and two screws and rarely of a police shield. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named "Jack Hammer" with a trademark symbol and "Drill Bit" in various merchandise and other media. He has a speaking role in The Mysterious Mare Do Well.

Jack Hammer's color scheme resembles those of Filthy Rich and Cherry Fizzy. His beard stubble is rarely not present, similarly to the beard stubble usually of "Rivet" and the mustache rarely of Lucky Clover.

In The Mysterious Mare Do Well, he appears once again as a construction worker, this time as an Earth pony, and has his first spoken line when he is rescued by Mare Do Well.

In Pinkie Pride, Jack Hammer briefly appears as a clean-shaven police officer during The Super Duper Party Pony and later as a construction worker during Pinkie's Lament.
